source.name: Moreirense FC: Placard.pt é o novo main sponsor do Moreirense
source.quote: Esta parceria contempla a presença de marca na frente das camisolas da equipa principal
source.note: Club announcement (page undated). Translation: 'This partnership includes brand presence on the front of the first team's shirts.' The same page names Placard.pt's owner as SAS Apostas Sociais, Jogos e Apostas Online S.A. (Jogos Santa Casa). The brand sits across the chest of the 2026/27 home shirt in the club's own shop and in launch photography.

source.name: Moreirense FC official shop: Camisola Principal 26/27
source.note: The page's front render of the 2026/27 home shirt (Camisola_Frente_S_Liga.png, embedded in the customizer) shows the 'tvi' logo at the top of the chest, above the Placard.pt main sponsor; same in worn kit at launch and in match photography. Page undated.

source.name: Moreirense FC official shop: Camisola Principal 26/27
source.note: The page's front render (Camisola_Frente_S_Liga.png) shows the 'Lusíadas' logo on the right sleeve; worn-kit launch photography (footylogos.com/kits/moreirense-2026-27) shows Lusíadas on both sleeves. Page undated.

source.name: Moreirense FC official shop: Camisola Principal 26/27
source.note: The page's back render (Camisola_Tras.png, embedded in the customizer) shows 'NUTRIBIO THE BIO LIFESTYLE' on the upper back, above the number area. Page undated.

source.name: Moreirense FC official shop: Camisola Principal 26/27
source.note: The page's back render (Camisola_Tras.png) shows 'ZOME REAL ESTATE GUIMARÃES ASA' on the lower back, below the number area. Page undated.

source.name: Footy Headlines: Moreirense 26-27 Home Kit Revealed
source.quote: Made by CDT, the new kit will be worn in the upcoming Portuguese Primeira Liga campaign.
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention; CDT's own site lists Moreirense FC under 'Sponsor' (cdt-equipamentos.com/moreirense-fc).

summary: Placard.pt (Jogos Santa Casa) across the front, tvi at the top of the chest, Lusíadas on the sleeve, Nutribio and Zome Guimarães ASA on the back; kit made by CDT. Not marked complete: no cited source shows the back of the shorts.
